Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer agent failed to extract the correct information from the search results. While the search results clearly displayed "Sicko (2007) Trailer HD | Documentary | Michael Moore" and other indicators confirming it is a documentary film, the agent incorrectly reported "No results found for 'Sicko Michael Moore documentary'" and claimed no relevant text was visible, despite the viewport containing explicit confirmation of the film's genre and director. This failure to recognize and report the visible evidence led to unnecessary repetition of the same failed search and prevented the conversation from concluding with the correct answer based on the available data.
